answer: River-Milestone Bond stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits to clear three river milestones. At each milestone it files an echo record, key-signed, proving its work. Auditors wander and replay records in the river log; reuse forfeits the bond. One fake costs 205; 1,000 fakes cost 205,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 165,000 loss. Rented milestones fail: hired hands cannot sign another's echo. Honest agents pay 135 once, keep bond, full share.
